shortDescription: TORONTO, ON / ACCESS Newswire / September 24, 2026 / Greenland Resources Inc. TSX:MOLYFWB:M0LY ("Greenland Resources" or the "Company") announces that it has adjourned its annual and special meeting of shareholders (the "Meeting") from the original meeting date of September 30, 2026 at 7:30 a.m. (T…

children: ") announces that it has adjourned its annual and special meeting of shareholders (the "

") from the original meeting date of September 30, 2026 at 7:30 a.m. (Toronto time) to the new date of October 9, 2026 at 7:30 a.m (Toronto time). The Meeting was adjourned in order to clarify certain matters disclosed in the management information circular as well as due to management time availability. In connection with the adjourned meeting, management has made available an amended and restated management information circular which includes details on the Meeting and which is available under the Company's issuer profile at www.sedarplus.com and at https://uplistadvisory.com/greeenland-res-2026-agsm.

Greenland Resources is a publicly listed Canadian and Greenlandic company developing Malmbjerg, a world-class Climax-type primary molybdenum deposit near tidewater in east-central Greenland. The project has a NI 43-101 Definitive Feasibility Study produced by Tetra Tech, a 30-year molybdenum and magnesium exploitation licence, an environmentally responsible mine design, and binding long term offtake agreements with major EU steel producers. Proven and probable reserves total 245 million tonnes grading 0.176% MoS2, containing 571 million pounds of molybdenum. As the high-grade molybdenum is mined for the first half of the mine life, the average annual production for years one to ten is 32.8 million pounds per year of contained molybdenum metal at an average grade of 0.23% MoS2, approximately 25% of EU total yearly consumption and 100% of EU defence needs. For more information, visit www.greenlandresources.ca or view the Company's Canadian regulatory filings at www.sedarplus.com.
